# Network 360 Release

August 19, 2025

The production release took place after 4:00 p.m. CDT, 8/19/2025. 

# Network360 Core Team

This Network360 release includes enhancements in Create a List and the Concise Office Export as well as fixes regarding security, global imports, Competitive Dashboard, user profiles, and the creation of new users.

# Enhancements



### Create a List

Now, the UI results include a NPI column displaying the provider’s NPI.  If the filed is blank, this means that the project data does not include an NPI for that provider. 

### Concise Office Export

Now, the Concise Office Export lists all offices that are associated with providers that match the search criteria.  In the past, the export contained only the list of offices that matches the list of “best” office that displayed in the UI. 

# Fixes



### Competitive Dashboard

Now when the user chooses to view results for confirmed providers, the Market Penetration graph and tooltip correctly display the results for confirmed providers (instead of displaying the directory provider results).  

### New User

Now a new user’s account activation link works correctly and does not display an error message. 

### User Profile

Now, the user’s “Print Name on PDF” selection is retained after the Update Profile button is clicked.
shortDescription: This Network360 release includes a major enhancement for Model Networks.  Now, users can upload a list of providers and zip codes to create a model network! This new functionality can also be accessed through the Adequacy feature.  The release also includes other enhancements in Create a List and the Concise Office Export as well as fixes regarding Competitive Dashboard, user profiles, and the creation of new users.
